text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I knew it! They've reproduced the setting of Rhodonite on this campsite!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
But I'm on my own... If I don't... f-find
some... "villagers" to join me...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh no! I lost sight of the firefly!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
W-wait, Taiki! You never know what could
be lurking in the forest at
night...

text_block_list.name: Taiki & Dober
text_block_list.text:
WAAAH!
NOOO!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: S-sorry I scared you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm sorry for screaming so loud.
I didn't
know you were here
camping too.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes! For some, um... treasure hunting.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Treasure hunting?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-yes! You see,
the natural features of this
campsite mimic the setting
of a children's
bo—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I mean,
not a book. It's a... movie. There's
a forest just like this one in
a movie I saw.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What?! That's amazing!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A-at first, I thought it was just a
coincidence, but I did some research, and
it turns out that the owner of this
campsite is the same person
who made the movie.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And now after exploring it for myself, I'm
certain. This campsite is a
puzzle for fans,
a secret map to the land of dreams!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Which means, there must be a mystical
stone somewhere around here that grants
wishes, the Dreamstone. So that's why I
came here... Um,
hello?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable! You're sayin' there's a
real-life adventure to be had
right here?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Taiki looks so excited. But of course,
she
loves this kind of thing. ...I
know! We
should join the treasure hunt!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Oh, but... springing that on Rob Roy
might intrude on her plans. It looks like
she came here alone, so maybe she wanted
to enjoy it
quietly on her own.)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, would you mind if we joined you on
your treasure hunt? We'll
have fun
together! It'll be exciting!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wait. Ah...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Please do! This story is about
individuals coalescing into a
single team to
find the treasure after all!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What does that mean? Having fun
together?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Five villagers, each with their own
qualities, come together and brave danger
in search of the wish-granting stone for
the sake of their
village.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
They're a ragtag bunch at first, but along
the way they learn to combine their skills
and ultimately achieve their goal.
The last 
chapter is a real tearjerker...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
S-sorry.
I got a little carried away! Anyway,
in the story, the traps are
impossible to
clear alone!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So I'd be thrilled if you were to lend
me a
hand!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Woohoo! Thank you! If we need five
people, then... Okay! I'll ask
those two
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yay! A treasure, treasure, treasure hunt!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you what Treasure Hunter El is
made of!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Th-thank you! I can't believe I get to go
looking for the Dreamstone
in a team of
five, just like in the story!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (...What now? I lied to them...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Rhodonite and the Dreamstone. No matter how many times I read it, I always get absorbed into its deep, intricate world!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(...Whoops. I only meant to check the
features of the forest, but I
ended up
reading through the story! I've got to go
take a bath!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(But... yeah. I am excited to see the
campsite.)

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy, do you have any booster serum I
could borrow? I left mine
in my room.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um, uh... B-booster? What's that?

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? You know, like, the first step of
your skincare routine. The one
that goes
on before toner.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, r-right. I'm sorry, I don't use those
kinds of—

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
I have some!
I did a bunch of odd jobs so I
could stock up. Here!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Wait, this is Violet! Are you sure?!

text_block_list.name: Classmate C
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! I use that too! Curren Chan
introduced me to it. Apparently, it makes
your skin super glowy if you use the whole
line. I can only
dream of that though.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Wow. Look at everyone gathering round.
They're all smiling. So this
is what they're
all into...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (I had no idea.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(...Should I know this kind of stuff? My
head's always in a book...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (This is a little embarrassing...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(The truth is, it's not really a movie,
it's a
children's book. I thought
it'd sound more
grown-up if I said movie, so...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I should set the record straight. But...
I'm
sure no one would really
mind either
way...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. It's fine. It'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy, come on! Let's go on our big
adventure!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, c-coming!
